columns.comment: Currency units per 1 USD on the date (USD = 1).
columns.name: rate_per_usd

columns.comment: USD value of one currency unit on the date (1 / rate_per_usd).
columns.name: usd_per_unit

columns.comment: Average usd_per_unit over the calendar month (for converting monthly flows such as revenue).
columns.name: month_avg_usd_per_unit

columns.comment: True on the last calendar day of the month (month-end revaluation rate).
columns.name: is_month_end

columns.comment: True when no rate was published that day and the previous published rate is carried forward.
columns.name: is_carried_forward

comment: Daily FX rates to USD for every gold currency over the dim_date window (1-Apr-2023 to 31-Mar-2027), dense: a day without a published rate carries the last published rate forward (is_carried_forward). USD value = amount_lcy x usd_per_unit (or amount_lcy / rate_per_usd); gold.fn_usd(amount, currency, date) wraps the lookup. Month-end rates: filter is_month_end. Grain: one row per currency per calendar day.
